stageNotes: Stage 1 (canonical): apex 403 on desktop Chrome UA, 200 on iPhone UA. www -> 301 -> apex (x-redirect-by: WordPress). Canonical = https://g4cgunstore.com.

Stage 2 (WAF): Cloudflare-active blocks desktop Chrome / curl / bot UAs and 10/10 rapid burst, SQLi, XSS, honeypots. SiteGround sgcaptcha (meta refresh /.well-known/sgcaptcha/) layered on top - triggers on rapid WP-REST sequential fetches. No homepage CAPTCHA; no age-gate.

Stage 3 (platform): WooCommerce - confirmed via /wp-content/plugins/woocommerce/* JS paths, woocommerce-Price-amount and product-grid-item CSS classes, woocommerce_params JS var, x-redirect-by: WordPress. Theme = Woodmart (wd-*/woodmart-* classes) but theme != platform (Mistake 39).

Stage 4 (catalog): /wp-json/wp/v2/product_cat returned 158 total cats, 22 parent=0. Sum of parent=0 counts = 6213 vs WP REST total = 5848 -> ~6% cross-listing overlap. Full walk-and-dedup BLOCKED by sgcaptcha mid-audit; kept ALL 22 parent=0 catalogUrls per Rule C ('never drop empty-today or seemingly-redundant categories without proof'). Brand sub-feeds (hornady, cadex, kel-tec) likely overlap firearms/ammunition - operator should prune via Playwright re-walk.

Stage 4g (extraction): /product-category/firearms/ page 1 returned 24 products (data-loop=1..24) with product-grid-item, data-product_id, valid /product/<slug>/ URLs. Homepage Featured Ammunition section validated 3 priced products. Extraction works.

Stage 5 (pagination): WC /page/{N}/ path confirmed (/page/1, .../page/88 visible in firearms category HTML). perPage=24 from page 1 product count. perPage select UI exposes ?page=12|24|36|48 - max=48 NOT verified due to sgcaptcha block; conservative ship perPage: 24.

Stage 6 (sort): <select name='orderby'> options: menu_order (default), popularity, rating, date (Sort by latest), price, price-desc. 3-outcome counter-control test BLOCKED by sgcaptcha. sortParam = '?orderby=date' recorded but sortVerified = false; runtime must re-verify.
Stage 7 (watermark): chose api-date-since-watermark (canonical WC behavior). Two-probe ?after= validation BLOCKED. Runtime crawler must use waf-cookie-manager to confirm.

Stage 8 (count): expectedProductCount = 5848 from /wp-json/wp/v2/product?per_page=1 x-wp-total header (verified pre-sgcaptcha). WC Store API blocked by Cloudflare 403 even with iPhone UA - cannot use store-api as count source. wp-rest-header is the only working path.
Stage 9 (assembly): emitted candidate + markdown twin; validator not run programmatically (operator gate).
